technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong short-term technicals (hull flip, volume spike, MACD crossover) offset by longer-term weakness (below 50-day averages, RSI21 oversold, negative CMF) and neutral sector backdrop.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 24 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member in fear-dominated market with no recent news data; insufficient conviction for actionable signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.6) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 24 days adds moderate event risk to already hostile volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, 15x volume spike, and MACD crossover provide genuine short-term momentum confirmation with price near support (37.07) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (342.6), price below both 50-day averages, RSI21 oversold (reversal trap risk), negative CMF, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event in 24 days create a hostile risk/reward environment that overwhelms technical setup.
